- On-prem network/egress window for private deployment tests — needs your infra team to confirm the maintenance window; currently listed as "TBD."
- Procurement signature + legal redlines resolution — procurement indicated an internal approval megacycle that could add 5 business days.

Proposed mitigations and next steps:
1) I attached a draft MAP v2 with a tight critical path and owner assignments.
2) If you can confirm the maintenance window by EOD Wednesday we can lock in the private deployment test date.
3) Laura from our legal ops will take a single consolidated redline pass if ClearPath sends comments to procurement@clearpath.com by Thursday COB.

I'll also include an escalation note to our Sales Lead to provide a one-paragraph executive commitment if that helps with your procurement deadline.

New suggested close: May 14, 2027 (contingent on SOC artifacts and network window). If anything needs to move faster we can discuss a limited scope GA with hosted API first while private deployment completes.

Best,
Olga

Olga / Laura — I reviewed the MAP v2 and risk register. Quick notes:

1) Hosted API interim: yes, we can offer a scoped hosted-API cutoff to get ClearPath started on eval traffic. That reduces the private infra dependency from critical path to secondary. Tradeoffs: no private-networked KV cache for session affinity (minor for POC); SLA parity requires Reserved capacity for predictable latency — estimate 48–72 hours to provision if they commit.

2) SOC artifacts: our Compliance team can compile the requested artifacts in 3 business days if Victor confirms exactly which extracts they need. We can accelerate to 2 days with a scoped artifact list.

3) Escalation: I recommend offering a one-time credit (up to 5% of first month committed spend) if procurement requires additional sign-off time beyond May 14. That keeps the close window visible without an open-ended concession.

I'll attach the risk register with my readiness flags.
